generated.what_happened: Cleveland Guardians third baseman José Ramírez reached 1,000 career RBIs after hitting a sixth-inning solo home run in a 5-3 win over the Athletics. With this blast, he became the second player in franchise history, alongside Earl Averill, and the 12th active Major League Baseball player to hit the milestone. Despite managing lingering discomfort from hand surgery performed earlier this season, Ramírez went 2-for-4 with two RBIs during the game. The victory improved the Guardians to a 79-75 record, helping them secure first place in the American League Central.
